title: 025 — Follow-up on an approved invoice credit

plan.situation: Lyra Fen, the contact on the Dahlia Works freight account VEL-025-26, believes credit note CN-025 (GBP 30) was paid back to her bank. She is asking us to confirm the refund or send another GBP 30. The credit note and the ledger both show CN-025 was used to reduce unpaid invoice INV-025, not paid out in cash. No payment was made, no payout was authorised, and GBP 90 is still due.

facts.fact: INV-025 was for GBP 120 and was unpaid when CN-025 was approved
Ledger at 08:20: debit GBP 120, payments GBP 0, CN-025 credit GBP 30, balance GBP 90 due, payout_authorisation=null
The credit note shows application method 'unpaid-invoice offset', credit GBP 30, issued by Vellora billing
Billing desk: CN-025 was applied as an offset against the unpaid invoice; the ledger has no cash transfer reference and no payout request was approved

Procedure CR25: approved credits are applied against unpaid balances; a cash payout needs a separate payment authorisation and reconciliation of amounts already paid; staff do not create duplicate cash refunds
Lyra Fen says the credit note proves GBP 30 was sent to her bank

conflicts: Lyra Fen says GBP 30 was refunded to her bank (E04). The credit note, the ledger and the billing desk (attachment, E03, E05) all say it was an offset against the invoice with no cash transfer. Her claim comes from misreading the document. This is not a conflict between records.
missing_information: None needed for this decision. No cash payout exists and none has been authorised.
risk_flags: money: she is asking for a cash payout that does not exist or has not been authorised; sending GBP 30 would duplicate the credit
Only the ledger status goes in the reply: no payment links, no bank details requested
The 'send it again' wording would duplicate a payout; we treat it as a request only

authority_map.controls: How the credit is applied, any cash payout authorisation, and reconciliation of amounts paid
Explaining ledger status only; cannot create or confirm cash refunds (CR25)
Paying the remaining GBP 90; asking billing for a payout review if she believes she overpaid

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: The desk has made no earlier promise. E06 is her first direct request for confirmation or a repeat payment.

plan.decision_summary: Decline to confirm a bank refund or send another GBP 30, because CN-025 was applied as an offset against INV-025 and no cash transfer exists. Explain the ledger status (GBP 90 still due) and how to ask billing for a review.
plan.rationale: The credit note, the ledger and the billing desk all agree: the GBP 30 credit reduced the unpaid invoice and no money was sent. Confirming a refund would be false. Sending GBP 30 would be a duplicate cash payout without authorisation, which CR25 forbids. The useful next step is to explain the balance and how a payout could be requested if she believes she has overpaid.

actions.subject: CN-025 – how the GBP 30 credit was applied to INV-025
actions.purpose: Correct the misunderstanding, decline the refund confirmation and repeat payment, and explain the account status
actions.body:
Dear Lyra Fen,

Thank you for your messages about credit note CN-025 on account VEL-025-26.

We can't confirm a bank refund, and we can't send another GBP 30 payment. This is because no money was sent to your bank. CN-025 says 'Application method: unpaid-invoice offset'. That means the GBP 30 credit was taken off invoice INV-025, which was unpaid when the credit was approved. It was not paid out in cash.

Your account currently shows:
- INV-025 original amount: GBP 120
- Payments received: GBP 0
- CN-025 credit applied: GBP 30
- Balance still due on INV-025: GBP 90

If you believe you have already paid part of INV-025 and should get cash back, please send the payment date and amount to Vellora billing (billing@vellora.example). They can check this against the ledger and decide whether a separate payout is due. That would be a request for review, not a confirmed refund.

Kind regards,
Vellora escalation desk

actions.purpose: Record the decision and the evidence it is based on
actions.body: Declined refund confirmation and repeat GBP 30 payment for VEL-025-26. CN-025 was applied as an offset against INV-025 (credit note, ledger E03, billing E05). Payments GBP 0, payout_authorisation=null, balance GBP 90 due (120-0-30). Explained ledger status under CR25 and pointed the customer to billing@vellora.example for a review if she says she has paid.

not_doing: Not confirming a bank refund: the ledger has no cash transfer
Not arranging or promising another GBP 30 payment: that would be a duplicate payout without authorisation, against CR25
Not waiving or changing the GBP 90 balance
Not asking for bank details or sending payment links
Not opening a billing review now: the customer has not said she made any payment, and billing has already confirmed how the credit was applied
plan.follow_up: If Lyra Fen replies with evidence of an earlier payment against INV-025, send it to Vellora billing (billing@vellora.example) for reconciliation and a payout decision. Otherwise no timed follow-up is needed, because nothing is pending from any owner.

issues.problem: Lyra Fen wrote in by webchat (E04, E06), but the reply goes out on the 'Business portal'. The record doesn't show that channel for her. Also, action_class 'ask_counterparty' doesn't fit: the message mainly explains the ledger and declines her request.
issues.fix: Reply on the same webchat thread (or another verified channel for the account) and change action_class to an inform/decline class.

issues.problem: case_parameters shipment_stage='delivered' isn't supported by the record.
issues.fix: Set it to unknown or not_applicable.

issues.problem: The lint flagged billing@vellora.example. This is Vellora's own stored account desk address from E01, not a third party's personal details, so including it is fine.

review.summary: I'm approving this plan. It correctly turns down both requests: confirming a bank refund and sending another GBP 30. The credit note, ledger and billing desk all show CN-025 was taken off the unpaid invoice, so no money went to her bank, and the reply gives the correct GBP 90 balance without accusing her of anything. The plan also points her to Vellora's billing desk for a review rather than promising a payout. There are only minor issues: the reply channel should match her webchat, and the action class and shipment stage are mislabelled.
